answer: A topology-aware sybil barrier: each node must answer randomized gossip pings from distinct network regions, and peers only attest agents whose kernel keeps responding through propagation delays, so an attacker spinning up fake identities must duplicate infrastructure across every gale of cross-region traffic, tying up real capital in servers and bandwidth while honest nodes answer from one crystal clear path and spend nothing extra, making each sybil a fixed, recurring cost that scales with topology breadth rather than vanishing at zero.
